(B) [7, 8, 9, 71, 81, 91]
(C) [7, 8, 9, 710, 810, 910]
(D) [7, 8, 9, 70, 80, 90]
(E) [7, 8, 9, 700, 800, 900]
(F) [7, 8, 9, 74, 84, 94]
(G) [7, 8, 9, 77, 87, 97]
(H) [7, 8, 9, 75, 85, 95]
(I) [7, 8, 9, 72, 82, 92]
